results.summary: The owner reported a delayed airbag recall repair because the replacement part was unavailable.
The owner reported brake lights remaining illuminated after pedal use. Replacing a suggested switch did not resolve the problem.
Pump failure reported; the original complaint identifies the pump as MSG.
The owner reported the transmission disengaging and the vehicle shutting down while moving, with operation limited to cold conditions.
The driver reported an unexpected driver-side airbag deployment during freeway travel.
The driver reported the transmission disengaging at highway speed, followed by rapid deceleration while coasting. The complaint named the SMG hydraulic pump.
The driver reported a loud rearward noise followed by sliding, then a near collision while pulling off the highway.
The report describes a detached cooling fan damaging the hood and engine compartment shortly after people had stood near the open hood.
